capabilities: 10 agent virtual: 5 operator (LLM) + 1 QC (LLM) + 1 cutting (scripted) + 1 inventory (scripted) + 1 ppic (scripted) + 1 supervisor (idle)
LLM-selective: operator & QC pakai Qwen 2.5 7B lokal (llm_decision_rate 44–94% tergantung beban)
Rule-based: scripted agent + fatigue curve + anomaly generator (deterministik dengan seed)
Multi-step bundle: DRAFT → CUTTING → SEWING → QC → DONE dalam 1 run (refresh allowed_actions dari Django)
Multi-hari: N hari non-stop via loop, Django sebagai source of truth, bundle unfinished di-resume
Overlap antar-bundle: bundle A di CUTTING, B di SEWING, C di QC bersamaan (N× event per tick)
SO dinamis: ORDER_IN jam 08:00/11:00/14:00 → cutting agent create WO + bundle
Jeda realistis: delay acak 0.5-5s + idle prob 25%
In-flight guard: cegah race condition async (bundle + operator)
Bundle registry shared: anti stale state antar agent
KPI lengkap: total_actions, success, error, latency p50/p95/p99, llm_decision_rate, by_agent, by_endpoint
JSONL append-only: replay-ready, trace via X-Request-ID
Fail-safe: LLM error → fallback scripted, bundle invalid → skip, OrderLine tanpa product → skip
Auto-refresh cookie: sesi expired → refresh otomatis via admin login
.env loader: DJANGO_SIM_COOKIE/USERNAME/PASSWORD dari file

yang_bisa_ditambah_nanti: DAG multi-WC penuh (seed RoutingStep + WorkCenter di Django)

Rework loop simulator (QC → rework → QC ulang)

decisions_log: Simulator = klien API biasa, Django-agnostic (Prinsip #2 blueprint)
LLM hanya di tempat ambigu (operator, QC), sisanya scripted (Prinsip #1)
1 proses async, N agent — bukan N proses (Prinsip #4)
Django = single source of truth, simulator tidak simpan state persisten
Replay = regression, semua HTTP + decision terekam JSONL
Tool whitelist per role, di luar whitelist = error
Multi-step refresh allowed_actions dari Django (hindari stale state)
In-flight guard: bundle + operator (cegah race condition async)
Bundle registry shared antar agent (anti stale)
Fail-safe LLM: error → fallback scripted (jangan crash)
Auto-refresh cookie: session expired → login ulang otomatis
Auth per-method (GET AllowAny, POST IsAuthenticated) — backward-compat
Endpoint create WO/bundle di Django (FASE 3.4 D1) — pakai service existing
Resource order-lines didaftarkan (FASE 3.4 P1) — pola sama seperti work-orders
